title: Dexcom Share: Ability to Specify Seconds Until Polling Retry or Allow Double Poll Retry
symptom: When following a Dexcom G6 via Dexcom Share, the xDrip follower polls every 5 minutes; if the reading hasn't reached the Dexcom Share servers yet (often in low cellular signal areas), it waits a hard-coded 20 seconds, retries once, and if that still fails it waits another 5 minutes. This causes readings to be 5–10 minutes behind 30–40% of the time.
cause: xDrip polls the Dexcom Share server at the expected reading time, but the reading is frequently not yet uploaded (especially with low cellular signal), and the single hard-coded 20-second retry is too short; when that fails xDrip gives up until the next 5-minute cycle. A contributor also suspected a bug in the shared anticipation code (`Anticipate.java`).
fix: Workaround used by some participants: set the follower phone's system time 10–15 seconds behind real time. A maintainer implemented an optional delay for the Dexcom Share follower in PR #3663, but it was never merged and the issue/PR were closed.
settings_changed: System time → 10-15 seconds behind real time
evidence_quote: What has alleviated having to manually restart the collector 50+ times each day was to use @olorinmaia suggestion to set the parent follower phone's system time 10-15 seconds behind real time.
